=== CONSENSUS FINDINGS ===
- .github/workflows/test-and-mark-stable.yml:469-472, 1417-1431 | severity=nit | confidence=4
  flagged_by: [deepseek_deepseek-v4-pro, minimax_minimax-m3, moonshotai_kimi-k3, qwen_qwen3_7-plus]
  PROBLEM: The serial-budget guard derives the review phase budget from the unclamped `REVIEW_STEP_TIMEOUT`, while the runtime wait-review step clamps it to `REVIEW_STEP_TIMEOUT_MAX=90`, causing valid operator overrides above 90 minutes to be falsely rejected.
  WHY: The validation path can exceed the 300-minute job budget and exit before artifact creation even though the runtime clamp would produce a serial budget within the limit; all reviewers classified this as a low-severity false rejection.
- .github/workflows/test-and-mark-stable.yml:2902-2924, 2952-2978 | severity=high | confidence=4
  flagged_by: [moonshotai_kimi-k3]
  PROBLEM: The pinned-run API read and its retry `continue` occur before the label-based success check, so persistent pinned-run read failures prevent the loop from recognizing an already-established successful terminal label state.
  WHY: During an Actions API outage or sustained rate limiting while the Issues endpoint remains available, the poller can miss the accepted success transition, wait until `PHASE_TIMEOUT`, and hard-fail the release gate; the source reviewer labeled this severity MAJOR.

=== END CONSENSUS FINDINGS ===

- .github/workflows/test-and-mark-stable.yml: lines 469-472 (serial-budget guard computing REVIEW_EFFECTIVE_BUDGET_MINUTES from unclamped REVIEW_STEP_TIMEOUT) vs lines 1419-1429 (wait-review step clamping REVIEW_STEP_TIMEOUT to REVIEW_STEP_TIMEOUT_MAX=90) | severity=NIT | confidence=3
  PROBLEM: The pre-artifact serial-budget guard computes `REVIEW_EFFECTIVE_BUDGET_MINUTES` from the unclamped `REVIEW_STEP_TIMEOUT` env value, while the runtime wait-review step first clamps `REVIEW_STEP_TIMEOUT` to `REVIEW_STEP_TIMEOUT_MAX=90`.
  WHY: An operator override of e.g. `review_step_timeout=105` produces guard budget 2*30+60+105+25+30+10+20=310 > 300, rejecting the configuration before test-issue creation, while the post-clamp runtime would use max(60,90)=90 for a budget of 295 < 300.

=== FINDINGS FROM minimax_minimax-m3 ===
- .github/workflows/test-and-mark-stable.yml: lines 469-472 (Validate prerequisites serial-budget compute) vs lines 1417-1423 (wait-review REVIEW_STEP_TIMEOUT clamp) and lines 1426-1429 (REVIEW_PHASE_WALL_BUDGET_MINUTES compute) | severity=NIT | confidence=3
  PROBLEM: The Validate prerequisites guard computes `REVIEW_EFFECTIVE_BUDGET_MINUTES` from the raw, unclamped `REVIEW_STEP_TIMEOUT` env value, while the wait-review loop clamps `REVIEW_STEP_TIMEOUT` to `REVIEW_STEP_TIMEOUT_MAX=90` before computing its own `REVIEW_PHASE_WALL_BUDGET_MINUTES`.
  WHY: With `review_step_timeout=100` and `review_timeout=60`, Validate computes `max(60,100)=100`, making `E2E_SERIAL_BUDGET_MINUTES=305 > 300` and exiting 1, while runtime clamps to 90 and the real serial budget is 295 < 300.

=== FINDINGS FROM moonshotai_kimi-k3 ===
- .github/workflows/test-and-mark-stable.yml: lines 2902-2924 (pinned-run read with `sleep`/`continue` on failure) versus lines 2952-2978 (label-driven success transition) | severity=MAJOR | confidence=4
  PROBLEM: The pinned-run read and its `continue` on failure occur before the label-based success check, so the loop never reaches the success evaluation at line 2960 while the pinned-run read keeps failing.
  WHY: During a partial GitHub outage or sustained rate limiting while the Issues endpoint still answers, the poller can miss the accepted success transition, wait until `PHASE_TIMEOUT` (30m), and exit 1 despite a successful simulation.
- .github/workflows/test-and-mark-stable.yml: lines 469-472 (Validate prerequisites `REVIEW_EFFECTIVE_BUDGET_MINUTES`) versus lines 1419-1431 (wait-review clamp to `REVIEW_STEP_TIMEOUT_MAX=90` before the wall-budget computation) | severity=NIT | confidence=3
  PROBLEM: The serial-budget guard derives the review phase budget from the unclamped `REVIEW_STEP_TIMEOUT` job env value, while the runtime clamps `REVIEW_STEP_TIMEOUT` to 90 before computing `REVIEW_PHASE_WALL_BUDGET_MINUTES`.
  WHY: With default sibling budgets, an operator override of `review_step_timeout` of 96 or more makes the guard compute 305m > 300m and exit 1 before any artifact is created, although the runtime would clamp to 90 and the real serial budget would be 295m.
- .github/workflows/test-and-mark-stable.yml: lines 2887-2960 | severity=MAJOR | confidence=4
  PROBLEM: Label-success evaluation is gated behind the pinned-run API read.
  WHY: The suggested minimal fix is to evaluate the `REVIEW_BLOCKED_PRESENT/TERMINAL_LABEL_PRESENT` success transition immediately after the label read and before the pinned-run read, keeping the pinned-run read for activity/failure attribution only.

=== END FINDINGS FROM moonshotai_kimi-k3 ===
